paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.99% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+0.70%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.59%). Brent crude changed -1.75% to 104.2. Gold changed +1.39% to 4,165.1001. Bitcoin changed -1.86% to 81,548.5703. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.19%, a relative move of -0.52%. Among the firms tracked, Lazard (-5.09%) and Bank of America (-4.76%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: BlackRock pulls in $205bn to take assets to record high (FT Markets). World’s largest asset manager has become an increasingly powerful force in private capital after acquisitions of HPS and Global Infrastructure Partners Deals and capital markets: General Atlantic’s IPO ambitions (FT World). The private capital group is planning to go public in the first half of next year as it seeks to keep pace with listed rivals like Blackstone and Apollo Global Central banks and macro: US inflation jumps to 3.7% as Iran war drives up prices (FT World). Rebound in fuel costs has piled pressure on voters ahead of midterm elections Central banks and macro: US inflation again set to be a crucial factor for the midterms (FT World). Donald Trump was re-elected on the back of inflation anger, and his party is now in danger of losing control of the House and Senate for the same reason
